title: TD Marketing: password reset for team members, and a Forgot your password link
text: A team member who cannot get in can now be helped. On the Team page an owner can make a one-time reset link for a person (valid 24 hours, shown once, to copy and send), and the Team page shows the workspace link to copy. The CRM login page has a "TD Marketing login? Forgot your password?" link that emails a one-hour link.
points: A reset also forgets the devices the person had marked as remembered; using Forgot does not cancel a link an owner already made.
If the Forgot email cannot be sent, Antonio is alerted; the public Forgot form is limited to 5 requests a minute; every message is also in Italian.
Not covered yet: resetting a lost authenticator, and sessions already open elsewhere are not ended by a reset.
